title: 4th International Workshop on Causality, Agents and Large Models
summary: International workshop at ANT 2027 on causal reasoning, agentic AI, explainable AI, large language models and adaptive multi-agent systems, with attention to transparency, accountability and human-agent collaboration.
notes: Six pages maximum including figures, tables and references, using the Elsevier Procedia Computer Science template. Review by 2–3 programme-committee members. Notification: 10 January 2027; camera-ready: 20 January 2027. Accepted papers are scheduled for oral presentation and at least one author must register and attend. EasyChair submission: https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=calm27. CALM-27 does not inherit any ranking assigned to the host ANT conference.
